(b) Advantage : No segregation of characters in hybrid progeny / Apomictic hybrid can be used to grow crop year after year / economical as ordinary hybrid seeds are costly = 1
Disadvantage : Can not control deleterious genetic mutation/it reduces genetic diversity from parents to offspring plants due to lack of variations (in asexual reproduction) / lack ability to adapt to changing environment $=1$

questions.q: Explain the events upto fertilization that occur in a flower after the pollengrain has landed on its compatible stigma.
